Priya K: Quick heads-up — Orbit (beta customer) confirmed 5 seats for next-week preview. Need to sync onboarding schedule and feedback loop. Any blockers?
Liam R: Thanks. I'll own the enablement demo. When do they want kickoff?
Aisha (CSM): They're available Tue/Wed afternoons PT. Prefer Wed 2pm PT. Can we do a 45-min walkthru + 30-min Q&A?
Jesse (Solutions): 45+30 works. I'll prepare integration checklist and a sample ingest script. cc @eng-deploy-bot for any infra notes
eng-deploy-bot: Scheduled: create a temporary sandbox cluster; ETA 24h. Link: https://redwood.internal/sandboxes/orbit-1755
Priya K: Great. Aisha, can you confirm which customer contacts will join? Need product champions + 1 engineer.
Aisha (CSM): Confirmed: Maria (PM), Ravi (Eng), and Nora (Ops). I'll send calendar invites once time is final.
Liam R: Can we add an optional "model behavior" mini-session (15m) covering prompt templates and safety knobs? Might surface early regressions.
Jesse (Solutions): Good call. Also requesting they enable metrics export (prometheus) so we can capture latency/failed calls during the pilot.
Aisha (CSM): I'll ask them to enable. Also flagging renewal risk: Orbit asked about rate limits and SLA for production. We should capture notes for sales.
Priya K: Noted. I'll add a renewal-risk tag to the account and file a short one-pager about capacity options for follow-up.
Liam R: For feedback loops — propose a shared Google sheet + weekly 15m sync for the first 3 weeks. If any major issues, escalate to #eng-sre.
Aisha (CSM): Sounds good. I'll publish the sheet and add the invite: https://docs.google.com/xyz
Priya K: Awesome. Action items: Liam (enablement deck), Jesse (integration checklist + prometheus hook), eng-deploy-bot (sandbox), Aisha (invites + sheet). I'll follow up with sales re: SLA ask. :thumbsup:
Aisha (CSM): On it. ETA invites by EOD Monday.
Liam R: ETA deck by Tue noon PT.
Jesse (Solutions): I'll drop the checklist in the sheet by Tue 5pm PT.
eng-deploy-bot: Sandbox ready: https://redwood.internal/sandboxes/orbit-1755/console
